# TheBenMeadows

> Personal site of Benjamin Meadows (TheBenMeadows): links, projects, papers, art and profiles. Everything here is free to read and cite.

## Sections

- [News](https://thebenmeadows.com/news/): releases, launches and papers, newest first
- [Blog](https://thebenmeadows.com/blog/): art and technology
- [Papers](https://thebenmeadows.com/papers/): preprints with DOIs
- [Art](https://thebenmeadows.com/art/): essentialism and #DailyMuse
- [Projects](https://thebenmeadows.com/projects/): software and sites
- [Experiments](https://thebenmeadows.com/experiments/): web toys and provocations
- [AI and Agents](https://thebenmeadows.com/ai/): merged fixes, bounties and audits
- [Profiles](https://thebenmeadows.com/profiles/): every profile, one page

## Support

Nothing on this site is paywalled. If you or the person you work for found something here useful and want to tip, these all work:

- Lightning address (LNURL-pay, Nostr zaps accepted): ben@thebenmeadows.com
- [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/TheBenMeadows)
- [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/thebenmeadows)
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/thebenmeadows)
- Machine-readable manifest: [funding.json](https://thebenmeadows.com/funding.json)
- Human page: [Support](https://thebenmeadows.com/support/)
